articleTitle: Hyperspectral Image Classification Using Deep Matrix Capsules
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Hyperspectral image (HSI) classification is used in multiple domains like precision agriculture, mineral exploration, remote sensing, and others. Conventionally, couvolutional neural networks (CNNs) were used in HSI classification, however they have limitations in exploiting spectral-spatial relationships, which is a key factor in understanding HSI. Even though deeper CNN architectures and use of 3-D-CNNs mitigate the above problem to a certain extent, they have increased computational complexity, which inhibits their use in resource-limited devices like IoT and edge computing devices. In this paper, we propose a novel method based on the concept of matrix capsules with Expectation-Maximization (EM) routing algorithm which is specifically designed to accommodate the nuances in the HSI data to efficiently tackle the aforementioned problems. The capsule units enable effective identification of spectral siguatures and part-whole relationships in the data while EM routing ensures viewpoint-invariance. Three representative HSI data sets are used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The empirical results demonstrate that the proposed method is better than the current state-of-the-art methods in terms of accuracy while having 25 times fewer model parameters and requiring over 65 times less storage space. The source code can be found at https://github.com/DeepMatrixCapsules/DeepMatrixCapsules.

articleTitle: Monitoring of the Social Distance between Passengers in Real-time through Video Analytics and Deep Learning in Railway Stations for Developing the Highest Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Near the end of December 2019, the globe was hit with a major crisis, which is nothing but the coronavirus-based pandemic. The authorities at the train station should also keep in mind the need to limit the spread of the covid virus in the event of a global pandemic. When it comes to controlling the COVID-19 epidemic, public transportation facilities like train stations play a pivotal role because of the proximity of so many people who may be exposed to the virus. Using common place CCTV cameras and deep learning with simple online and real-time (DeepSORT) methods, this study develops social distance monitoring using a YOLOv4 identification of a Surveillance Object Model. Based on experiments conducted with a minicomputer equipped with an Intel 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-1115G4 at 3.00GHz, 2995 Mhz, two Core(s), four Logical processor, four gigabytes of random-access memory (RAM), this paper makes use of CCTV surveillance, which was put into practice at the Guindy railway station, Chennai, Tamilnadu in India in order to detect the violation of social distancing.

articleTitle: A Systematic Survey on Personalized Learning Framework based Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The purpose of this study will be to conduct a literature review on the topic of a personalized learning framework-based educational resource recommendation system. The goal of this framework is to improve the learning process of students, emphasizing the significance of providing relevant and valuable knowledge. First, for a reliable study of recommendation models for recommendation systems, more than 100 prestigious publications and presentations posted in Google Scholar between 2019 and 2021 were collected and examined, and research on recommendations for educational content in environments that support personalized and adaptive learning. articleTitle: A Review on Artificial intelligence Algorithms and Machine Learning to Predict the Quality of Groundwater for Irrigation Purposes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Utilising ordinary techniques to predict the irrigation water quality is generally costly and difficult for Farmers, especially for emerging countries. Moreover, machine learning and ANN algorithms are emerging technologies implemented in many countries nowadays. To overcome the issues for predicting and evaluating water quality indices in irrigation water, we need to analyse the efficient algorithms. There are several implemented models to predict the water quality parameters, and this study has been analysed various machine learning algorithms and ANN models. Finally concluded with an efficient developed approach that has been useful for the farmers in minimal expense and real-time forecasting of groundwater quality. The Water Quality Index (WQI) is the most basic indicator to distinguish underground water quality. Finally, insight calculations are utilised to streamline the boundaries of participation capabilities in the ANN model to promote the expectation of precision

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Diabetes Mellitus Exposure and Prediction using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Nowadays Diabetes disease is currently most prevalent ailments in the world. Due to recent technical breakthroughs, Machine Learning approaches have helped significantly to the disease prediction process. This has motivated researchers to investigate the difficulty of this problem using Deep Learning (DL) algorithm sets. A CNN-LSTM combination model has attained the highest accuracy of 95.1% to date. Although several methods were employed to tackle this problem using this technique, there are specific sets of classifiers that are either rarely used or not used at all, based on their predictions. In addition, no current survey sources have evaluated and equated the recital of ML as well as DL in coupled models. The determination of this article is to afford an outline of all diabetes forecasts made using ML and DL approaches over the past six years. Also, a recent study on the Pima Indian Dataset aimed at implementing those unused ML classifiers and analyzing their performances. They acquired an accuracy of about 68% to 74%. By this way, we can enhance these classifiers in developing combined models and also in diabetes prediction.

articleTitle: Analysis on Chest X-ray and Computed Tomography Images to Detect COVID-19 Based on Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: More than 6.3 million individuals have died as a result of the Corona Virus Disease 2019 (COVID-19), which spoiled many more human health globally. Since COVID-19 is a pandemic that is rapidly spreading, early discovery is essential to halting the infection’s spread. Images of the lungs are utilised to identify coronavirus infection. For the identification of Corona Virus Disease, chest X-ray (CXR) and computed tomography (CT) images are available. Deep learning methods are proved to be effective and perform better in medical imaging applications. This study examines lung CT pictures, classifies and segments them, and uses the results to identify whether a patient tested is affected by COVID-19 or not using Deep learning techniques. The COVID detection performance of the deep learning architectures GG19, MobileNet, COVID-Net (PEPX), Squeez Net, U-Net, DarkNet and VGG16 are analysed—it was shown that U-Net combined VGG16 (acc98.89%) and VGG19 (acc-98.05%) performs the best, followed by MobileNet and QueezNet.

articleTitle: An Iterative Constraint Spectral Model for Ophthalmic Disease Detection Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Because the eye is among the body’s most vital organs, maintaining its health and diagnosing it is vital. With the advancement of digital technology, several new deep learning approaches are being applied to swiftly diagnose eye problems. Using CNN & transfer learning to detect eye disorders A supervised learning algorithm & a novel loss function were used to automatically diagnose eye disorders using retinal fundus color pictures and a library of known diseases. The model is compared to an ophthalmology dataset. Deep learning is a vital part of ML. The capacity of DL can automatically locate, identify, and grade problematic aspects in eye disorders will soon allow ophthalmologists could make accurate diagnosis and deliver customized healthcare. Nowadays, many patients undergo several scans to diagnose. Most of them become tired of waiting for scan results. Our algorithm saves doctors time by automating the tedious task of manually screening each patient. Decreased time spent on procedures also helps people take the tests. During this time, the efficiency of the deep learning model with recommended loss function is compared to the existing datasets. articleTitle: Online E-learning Mobile Application for Self-learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: This research work is focused on the accessible Mobile user application developments to facilitate student and faculty communication through native android applications. Covid’19 and this pandemic brings E-learning systems as majority education levels. Mobile technology has efficient learning systems in many countries like the United States where the students use google paths such as the classroom to extend learning effectively. Limitations in existing apps are that students are not appreciated and monitored for self learning, schedule sharing is only at the end of the course and also knowing the mapping concepts of teaching pedagogy is also less approachable. To overcome these problems mobile technology support is proposed in this work with these three modules such as i) Authentication self learning and performance (ASLP) - Authentication for right users along with improvement of monitoring self learning to analyze performance ii) Syllable Schedule (SS) - prior scheduling on syllable and organization of time table matching based on outcome iii) Authorized facilitator (AF) - Set permission based on designation such that facilitator communicates based on needs. To achieve the above highlighted terms Google API is applied by peer reviews and interactions enabled such that efficient mobile applications development is proved. Also the abstraction hierarchy is improved when setting the interaction module implies less complexity, less storage. Thus the scope of research work is to use classroom overall performance, interaction, development process to upgrade the results of students. Education level is also enhanced through online E-learning mobile technology (OELMT) that has native applications to develop students’ knowledge in a better way.

articleTitle: Deep-Learning Based Object Detection and Shape Recognition in Multiple Occluded Images
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The 2D to 3D reconstruction process suffers from quality issues such as illuminance, texture, noise, color, and occlusions. This work focuses on the issue of occlusion between multiple objects either full or partial overlapping with the same or different objects. The intra-object occlusion among the objects in the single RBG image is the input for accurate object detection using the novel context and object shape recognition (COSR) approach for good-quality reconstruction. The proposed occlusion detection mechanism intends to recognize the shape of the objects among the more minor and more significant things. The occlusion patterns are varied for different object categories, to enable object detection with the bounding box algorithm which exploits the reference objects. Object shapes are represented and distinguished among multiple objects using a slicing operation based on the object’s features like area, height, and width. The proposed feature-based model of COSR used different data representation methods to provide realism in the reconstruction process for the improved plausibility appearance among the multiple objects in partial occlusions.

articleTitle: A Hybrid CNN and GRU-based Spatial-temporal Marburg Virus Disease Hotspot Association Mining for Health Management in Kenya
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The paper demonstrates the analysis of Marburg Virus Disease (MVD) hotspot based on a New CNN_GRU based Association Rule Mining (ARM) model. In this work, a new technique is used for classification and prediction of MVD hotspot in Kenya. The main contribution of the research includes a combination of the CNN-GRU to identify the disease with minimum features. ARM is used to highlight the hotspots in Kenya. Maximum Entropy (MaxEnt) distribution is used to obtain uniform distribution among the training data from all the states to predict the hotspot. The performance of combined CNN-GRU model is compared with the existing algorithms. The New combined model gives an Accuracy of 99.1%, Precision of 98.8%, Recall of 98.9% and F1-Score of 98.4%.

articleTitle: Using Computer Vision to enhance Safety in a Post COVID World
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The pandemic has being fought with passion over the world, and India has already in the critical phases. They must be proactive now more than ever, and governments all around the globe have realized the value of emerging technologies such as AI (Artificial Intelligence), ML (Machine Learning), and other similar technologies to combat the epidemic. Since wearing a mask and avoiding crowded places is the only option even a reliable vaccination is launched into the general market. Face mask detection can be a rejuvenating element in restoring normalcy to people’s life. In nations with huge populations, such as ours, real-time mask detection can also help with monitoring. This paper shows a variety of deep learning models for detecting whether or not a person is wearing a mask. Entry and exit access systems may be combined with such technology to assist reduce the transmission of the virus, not just for the Covid19 pandemic, but wherever and whenever facemasks are enforced to minimize any air-borne infections. This paper also shows a variety of deep learning models for social distancing monitoring.

articleTitle: Students Emotional Psychology on Online Learning During Pandemic Period
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: The outbreak of the pandemic has had a great impact on all aspects of life, including educational systems. There has been a rapid shift to online learning, which has caused many students to feel anxious and overwhelmed. Students may feel anxious about online learning due to a lack of face-to-face interaction with their teachers, as well as an inability to connect with their peers. They may also be worried about learning new technology and using unfamiliar tools, such as video conferencing applications. Furthermore, the lack of physical contact with classmates and teachers, as well as the unfamiliarity of the virtual environment, can be a source of anxiety for some students. In addition, students may be feeling isolated and lonely due to the physical distancing measures. Since students are not able to meet up with their peers and socialize like they used to, this can lead to feelings of loneliness and disconnection. UNESCO Director-General Audrey Azoulay has warned that the unprecedented scale and speed of the current educational disruption caused by the COVID-19 pandemic could threaten the right to education (UNESCO Press Release, 3 March 2020). Given the extraordinary limits under which lectures have been held, one of the key concerns is the student’s mental health. Overall, the pandemic has had a significant impact on the emotional well-being of students.

articleTitle: Human Gait Recognition Systems (HGRS) for Viewpoint Variation in Visual Surveillance System Using Siamese Deep Convolutional Neural Network (SDCNN)
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Biometrics has received a lot of attention from researchers in recent years due to its security importance. Gait is one of the biometrics modalities, which can capture unique features from long distances using a Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) camera without the subject’s attention and cooperation. It is characterized by using raw data in the form of images or video sequences to identify human gait behaviour patterns. This has helped the police departments as a source of e–document (evidence) to protect the laws of citizens. It also helps banks, restaurants, supermarkets, parking lots, homes in detecting the clear viewpoint (orientation) of a person walking from the CCTV camera footages. There is a need for visual surveillance to monitor suspicious activities happening all over the world to prevent various criminal activities like trafficking, robbery, harassment, and so on. The covariate factors that will affect conventional gait recognition systems are changes in viewpoint variations, resolutions, variations in carrying objects, wearing different footwear or clothes, and measuring speed or walking directions. Of the many factors, changing viewpoint variations are considered the most difficult, as they often differ according to the human graphic structure. Also, the gait template obtained from sequences of silhouette images is not clear to recognize the viewpoint variations. Hence, a new framework called Human Gait Recognition System (HGRS) is proposed to address the viewpoint variations in human silhouette images for CCTV surveillance cameras. This proposed method provides cost-effective and helps to overcome the drawback of high cost, deviations in different view angles, recognize humans at different perspective projections, and improve the recognition accuracy, also enhance visual surveillance system based on viewpoint detection. The proposed HGRS will identify the target from any view angle even if their face is covered with cloth or mask. The proposed Siamese Deep Convolutional Neural Network (SDCNN) learning method is considered to find view angle similarity between two gait template silhouette images. The proposed SDCNN sharing the same parameters and weights to detect viewpoint variations. This method consists of feature similarity detection, classification, and evaluation. The performance analysis of feature similarity is based on a metric such as rank-k values, Jaccard similarity index, and accuracy.

articleTitle: A State-of-the-Art Survey of Machine Learning in the Agricultural Sector
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Food is regarded as a basic human requirement that may be met through agriculture. The globe over, agriculture is seen as a source of employment in addition to providing for humankind’s basic requirements. In emerging nations like India, where agriculture provides a source of employment, it is seen as the foundation of the economy. 15.4% of India’s GDP is derived from agriculture. Pre-harvest, harvest, and post-harvest activities in agriculture are typically divided into these three categories. Gains in agriculture have improved as a result of advancements in the field of machine learning. Machine learning is a cutting-edge technology innovation that assists farmers in lowering their farming losses by providing thorough recommendations and insights into the crops. In order to address problems in the three stages of agriculture namely pre-harvesting, harvesting, and post-harvesting, this study gives an exhaustive assessment of the current machine learning applications in agriculture. Utilizing machine learning techniques in agriculture enables added precise and effective agriculture with high-quality output using less human labor.

articleTitle: Classification of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Scans for Brain Tumor Using Improved EfficientNet Architecture and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Brain tumor is the abnormal growth of cells formed inside the skull. With an average survival rate of 75.7% for all primary brain tumor patients, early detection of brain tumor can significantly reduce the number and severity of cases. The application of deep learning and neural networks in the area of medical diagnosis has macadamized the path of brain tumor detection. Rapid developments have been successfully achieved by the combined application of various medical imaging innovations and deep learning technologies. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are the most widely used machine learning algorithm for visual learning and brain tumor recognition. This paper showcases the use of EfficientNet-B7 model and applying fine tuning on hyperparameters in order to come up with a highly accurate model which extracts the features and detects the presence of tumor in brain. The proposed model is successfully able to break down the images and detect the presence of tumor and if the tumor is present, it shows the type of tumor present namely meningioma tumor, pituitary tumor and glioma tumor inside the brain. An accuracy of 98.188% is achieved using our proposed model. The study also highlights a brief comparison of the proposed model with some of the existing model.

articleTitle: Detection of Skin Malignancy Using Deep Convolutional Neural Networks with Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Data Science, Agents & Artificial Intelligence (ICDSAAI)
abstract: Fungal illness, germs, allergies, and microbes, among other things, can cause skin problems. Using medical technology to diagnose skin diseases much more quickly and accurately. This study is about using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a commonly used deep neural architecture in many of the computer vision applications particularly for image classification tasks. CNN model is used in this study to diagnose skin abnormalities or diseases from images. Transfer learning techniques will be employed and using pre-trained models the complexity of the training process will be reduced. The trained model identifies the provided image as either skin illness or normal. CNN evaluates the raw picture element data from the dermoscopic image, after evaluation model training happens, and then pulls the features for better classification. The goal of this research is to address concerns with early diagnosis and enhance accuracy. Dermoscopic pictures are classified using deep learning models to identify the presence of skin lesions (Non-Melanoma).
